manifestations.description: Pain in his right leg exacerbated by prolonged standing, walking or even sitting, stair climbing and squatting
Obvious, albeit not pronounced, limp and walks comparatively slowly

treatments_received: open reduction with partial patellectomy, tension band wiring and screw fixing
second operation to remove broken wires
long arm cast for six weeks (left arm)
physiotherapy once or twice a week for about two years

losses.description: Pain in right leg causing difficulties and pain if required to remain on his feet for long periods; difficulty with stair climbing and squatting; an obvious limp
Prevents him resuming his previous occupation as a restaurant captain which involved long hours on his feet attending to customers
